t: Standardizing Widgets in Workflows using FastHTML and HTMX
s: This article details the enhancement of Pipulate's workflow UI by introducing `revert_control_advanced` and `finalized_content` methods, enabling consistent display of complex widgets alongside standard navigation controls using FastHTML and HTMX.
sub: Enhancing Pipulate's revert_control for complex content
Achieving visual consistency and reducing code duplication
Refactoring the Botify Export workflow with new components
